# Trace profiles

<!-- GENERATED by experiments/scripts/profile_traces.py - do not edit by hand. -->

This is the reference profile of every workload trace used for the LeaFTL / LearnedFTL
baselines. Regenerate it after adding or changing any trace:

```bash
python3 experiments/scripts/profile_traces.py
```

Machine-readable values for every number below are in `profiles.json` next to this file.

## Trace format

One request per line: `timestamp operation offset_bytes length_bytes`, where `operation` is
`R` or `W`. Lines starting with `#` are comments. Requests are expanded to 4 KiB logical
pages (LPNs) for every per-page statistic.

## Metric definitions

| Metric | Definition |
|---|---|
| SHA-256 check | File hash compared with `manifest.csv` and the Git LFS object id where available. |
| Read % (req / bytes) | Share of requests, and of bytes, that are reads. |
| Footprint | Distinct LPNs touched × 4 KiB. `Fits device` compares the highest byte address with the 30 GiB logical device used in the baseline runs. |
| Unique TPs (256 / 512) | Distinct translation pages touched with 256 LPNs per page (LeaFTL) and 512 (LearnedFTL). |
| Sequential share | Share of requests that start exactly where the previous request ended. |
| Top-k% share | Share of all page references that go to the hottest k% of distinct LPNs. |
| Working set | Distinct LPNs per window of 100,000 consecutive page references. |
| Read-after-write (RAW) share | Share of read LPNs whose address was written earlier in the trace. With precondition `none`, reads with no earlier write target unmapped space: LeaFTL counts them as CMT misses (docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md). With precondition `fill` every read is mapped. |
| Overwrite share | Share of written LPNs that overwrite an LPN written earlier in the trace. |
| Stack distance | Exact LRU stack distance on the read stream: distinct keys referenced since the previous reference to the same key. An LRU cache of capacity C hits iff stack distance < C. |
| LRU / LFU / Perfect-LFU / Belady hit rate | Hit rate over the read stream of: an LRU cache; an in-cache LFU cache (a key's count starts at 1 on insertion, rises on each hit and is discarded on eviction; the victim is the lowest count, ties to the least recently used); a perfect-LFU cache (counts persist across evictions, every reference counts; same victim rule); and Belady's optimal (MIN) cache. All assume every miss inserts. These are reference points on the read stream only. Real FTL CMTs differ: LeaFTL caches one learned segment per translation page and only inserts accurate segments of mapped pages; LearnedFTL also fills the CMT on writes and prefetches within a translation page. |
| Expected FTL counters | Values the FTL must report for this trace (Phase 2b invariant 10): requests and LPNs per operation, never-written reads, and the request-size histogram in LPNs. |

Keyings used for cache bounds:

- `tp256`: translation page, 256 LPNs/page (LeaFTL CMT key)
- `tp512`: translation page, 512 LPNs/page
- `lpn`: logical page (LearnedFTL CMT entry granularity)
